answer: Make each agent lock a refundable stake before it can transact, the way a builder stacks timber as collateral before work begins: a thousand fake identities would need a thousand stakes, so a Sybil flood costs real money up front. Honest agents earn their stake back from fees, while detected fakes forfeit it. Every staked identity is listed in a public registry with an opal-clear audit trail, and reputation accrues slowly, a sonnet of trust written over time, so a fresh sockpuppet cannot buy instant credibility.
